stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: Checkout's own ERROR-status span increases over the last 5 minutes are zero: service_name=checkout span_name=oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder = 0, oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems = 0, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge = 0, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart = 0, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct = 0 (increase over 300s, status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR).

In the full status breakdown for the same 5-minute window checkout spans appear only as STATUS_CODE_UNSET (oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 6.25, HTTP POST 6.25, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 6.25, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert 18.75, oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 6.25, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 12.50, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 6.25, oteldemo.ShippingService/ShipOrder 6.25); ERROR-labelled series exist with value 0 for checkout PlaceOrder/prepareOrderItems, cart POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, and no ERROR-status series was returned at all for currency, shipping or email.

Checkout's gRPC client metric for the last 5 minutes shows all calls with rpc_grpc_status_code="0": oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 5.00, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert 17.50, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart 5.00, oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 6.25, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 11.25, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 6.25, oteldemo.ShippingService/ShipOrder 5.00; the non-zero code series returned for the same service (code 13 GetProduct, code 2 Charge, code 9 EmptyCart) each have increase 0 in this window.

The checkout PlaceOrder duration histogram for the last 5 minutes places all 6.25 spans at or below 100 ms (le="100" = 6.25) and only 1.25 spans at or below 50 ms; in the comparable 5-minute window one hour earlier (16:36:31-16:41:31) 5.01 of 7.51 PlaceOrder spans were at or below 50 ms. Histogram buckets are cumulative.

Average span durations (ms), last 5 minutes versus the 16:36:31-16:41:31 baseline: checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 60.71 vs 47.17; checkout oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 9.84 vs 8.33; checkout oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 9.49 vs 6.78; checkout oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart 7.24 vs 6.04; email POST /send_order_confirmation 8.89 vs 7.00; shipping oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 7.53 vs 5.49; product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 0.21 vs 0.26; currency Currency/Convert 0.89 vs 1.11.

The 5-minute average of checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder over 14:41:31-17:41:31 (step 300s) ranges 21.19-95.49 ms within the final hour, with larger earlier excursions of 70964.82, 10398.48 and 36544.89 ms around 14:46-14:56; the same 3-hour view of checkout client spans shows oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 4.08-22.55 ms, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 3.30-14.28 ms and oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart 3.31-35.77 ms, each containing its current value.

The only ERROR-status spans in the last 5 minutes belong to ad (oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 2.50), frontend (GET 2.50, executing api route (pages) /api/data 2.50, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 2.50), frontend-proxy (ingress 2.50, router frontend egress 2.50) and load-generator (GET 2.50); no checkout, payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping or email span appears in that error query.

Per-5-minute ERROR-span counts from 16:41:31 to 17:41:31 are 0 for ad, frontend, frontend-proxy and load-generator in every bucket except the last one ending 17:41:31, where ad = 2.50, frontend = 7.50, frontend-proxy = 5.00 and load-generator = 2.50 appear; over the whole hour the only services with non-zero ERROR spans are ad, flagd, frontend, frontend-proxy, load-generator and recommendation.

ad oteldemo.AdService/GetAds increased by 2.50 spans with STATUS_CODE_ERROR and 8.75 spans with STATUS_CODE_UNSET in the last 5 minutes, so roughly a fifth of the ad GetAds spans in that bucket carried an error status.

The checkout trace sample (20 traces, 405 spans) shows no error-tagged rows in the 160 rows read: checkout spans carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0 or http.status_code=200, and the load-generator POST, frontend-proxy ingress / router frontend egress, frontend POST /api/checkout and email POST /send_order_confirmation spans inside those traces also carry HTTP 200. Trace ids include babf52c85d4be88cd0f39fb4b2e0fa91, 90a3a7a1032324765c288d1854fa66be, b1701f00357d9161c1dc6c41e15cd9f6, 4d56cfce19ed7af53429dd1fb67971ae, 1cb22e66a71b8b5ca2e43b578a4fc240, 1715dc52dcc3cea05907a63e0a3b67f4, aad9c1a80c674a121d2df02d8ca9c808 and 565b425fdc5d7d2b0b797b2beb738313.

app_payment_transactions_total increased by 7.50 transactions in app_payment_currency=USD and 0 in CAD on pod payment-6f7bc865d6-bfxbv (namespace otel-demo) in the last 5 minutes; the metric carries no transaction-status or failure label, so it cannot evidence charge failures in either direction.

The ad failure is partial, not service-wide: the 2 ad traces returned for the same 5-minute window show ad oteldemo.AdService/GetAds with rpc.grpc.status_code=0, frontend /api/data with HTTP 200 and frontend-proxy ingress with HTTP 200 (trace ids a27d8a22601b0a01500929ef2d4b19ee and d87db41e97d8a6f77890182c2a79dbad), so the ad calls in this sample succeeded.

Rejected: a checkout dependency (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping or email) is failing and only appears healthy because checkout client spans are recorded as STATUS_CODE_UNSET. Checkout's rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count series report rpc_grpc_status_code="0" for all seven outbound methods with zero increase on the non-zero status-code series, and every traced dependency call in the sample returned grpc status 0.
